cases.name: every_functional_descends
cases.reason: For p(x,y)=x and lambda(x,y)=y, lambda(0,1)=1 on a kernel element.

cases.name: zero_square_meets_positive_sphere_bound
cases.reason: Unknot threshold is 1; zero square is excluded.

cases.name: positive_betti_number_implies_odd_form
cases.reason: Hyperbolic form H has b2+ equal to one and is even; the blowup supplies oddness.

cases.name: one_blowup_always_has_nonzero_signature
cases.reason: Signature one requires the second negative blowup for this signature safeguard.

cases.name: nonzero_tensor_over_every_ring
cases.reason: Z/2 tensor_Z Z/3 is zero: multiplication by 2 and 3 annihilates it, hence Bezout gives annihilation by 1.

cases.name: nonzero_lee_space_implies_nonzero_associated_graded
cases.reason: The exhaustive filtration F_q=Q^7 for every q has zero associated graded.

cases.name: finite_upper_bound_excludes_minus_infinity
cases.reason: Minus infinity satisfies every finite upper bound.

cases.name: kernel_plateau_certifies_tail_stability
cases.reason: A one-dimensional identity prefix followed later by zero changes the kernel after any prescribed plateau.

cases.name: one_zero_transition_forces_zero_limit
cases.reason: A zero map once, followed by identities, has a surviving later-stage Q; eventual death is required for every representative.

cases.name: finite_prefix_forces_nonzero_limit
cases.reason: Identity forever and the same identity prefix followed by zero forever have respective limits Q and zero.

cases.name: tensor_with_zero_can_be_cancelled
cases.reason: Q and Q^2 are unequal although both become zero after tensoring with zero.

cases.name: nonzero_infinite_factor_can_always_be_cancelled

cases.name: all_gluck_maps_are_degree_zero
cases.reason: Intersection two gives the displayed shift (-2,2), so only an appropriate zero-intersection restriction removes it.

cases.name: integral_gluck_theorem_from_rational_statement
cases.reason: A Q-vector-space theorem supplies no integral conclusion; distinct torsion groups can rationalize to zero.

cases.name: accepted_body_equals_v3_from_status_metadata
cases.reason: An accepted date and revised date contain no equality evidence for manuscript bytes.

cases.name: finite_controls_are_topology_proof
